title: OpenAI announces three big science discoveries and a new way to work with academics
hook_text: OpenAI just dropped three new science breakthroughs.
script:
OpenAI just dropped three new science breakthroughs in math, computer science, and physics.
External academic experts acting as shepherds guided these exact results.
This comes less than a month after hundreds of manuscripts solved long-standing math questions.
Working directly with external researchers helps validate complex automated problem-solving.
Would you trust academic shepherds to supervise complex AI discoveries?
